cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Shops, money and paying; coins, notes, cards and receipts show no readable numbers or writing.

words.en: We go to the shop for milk.
words.scene: Lily and Mum walking into a small local shop with a blue awning, glass windows showing fruit inside.
more: I like to shop for clothes.
The new shop is near our house.

words.en: We do the shopping on Saturdays.
words.scene: Mum and Lily carrying full shopping bags home.
more: I help Mum with the shopping.

words.scene: Mum and Lily pushing a big shopping trolley down a supermarket aisle, tall shelves of food on both sides, Tom sitting in the trolley holding an orange.
A wide view of a supermarket aisle, tall shelves stacked with cereal boxes and tins, bright lights above.
more: We buy food at the supermarket.
There are many people in the supermarket.

words.scene: a big department store with many floors and moving stairs inside.
more: Sam's aunt works in a department store.
Sam 的阿姨在百货商店工作。

words.en: I go to the corner store.
words.scene: a small corner store with fruit outside.
Lily choosing a book in a cosy bookshop with full shelves.
more: We read books in the bookshop.

words.scene: A grown-up young woman shop assistant in her twenties with a name badge folding t-shirts on a table in a clothes shop, colourful clothes on rails behind her.
more: Ask the shop assistant for help.

words.scene: A grown-up young man shop assistant in his twenties kneeling in a shoe shop and helping Lily try on a red shoe, Mum watching.
A grown-up man customer in a coat paying with coins at a café counter, a grown-up woman behind the counter handing him a cup of coffee.
more: We are customers at the shop.

words.sz: 这位购物者拿着红色的袋子。
words.scene: shoppers with many bags in a busy shopping street.
more: 一位开心的购物者走回家。

words.scene: Tom holding up a yellow banana, looking at Mum to buy it.
more: I want to buy a pen.

words.scene: Dad paying at the checkout with a card.
more: Lily pays for her ice cream.

words.en: Lily spends her money on books.
words.scene: Lily putting coins into a piggy bank, looking at a stack of books nearby.
more: We spend time in the park.

words.scene: Tom looking at a shiny toy car, thinking about the price.
more: The ticket is not expensive; it doesn't cost much.

words.scene: Lily and Mum comparing two jackets, looking at the small price tags (no numbers).
more: What is the price of the apple?

words.scene: Lily happily holding a cheap toy from a market stall. cheap and expensive must look clearly different.
Mum looking surprised at a very expensive shiny watch in a glass case.

words.en: Can I try on these shoes?
more: Try on this jacket. It's nice.
试穿一下这件夹克，挺好看的。
Mum tries on a new dress.

words.scene: a family looking at a house with a big board in the garden (no writing).
more: The old bike is for sale.
Is this toy car for sale?

words.en: Grandma pays for the strawberries in cash.
words.scene: Grandma counting paper money from her purse (no readable numbers).
more: I only have cash in my pocket.
Dad went to the bank to cash a cheque.
爸爸去银行兑现了一张支票。

words.en: Mum pays with a credit card.
words.scene: Mum paying with a credit card at a shop (no writing on the card).
more: Do you have a credit card?
Dad lost his credit card yesterday.
爸爸昨天弄丢了信用卡。

words.en: Grandpa writes a cheque for the rent.
words.sz: 爷爷写了一张支票付房租。
words.scene: Grandpa writing a cheque at a table (no readable writing).
more: The bank gave Dad a new cheque book.
银行给了爸爸一本新的支票簿。

words.en: The waiter brings Dad the bill.
words.sz: 服务员给爸爸送来了账单。
words.scene: A grown-up waiter in a white shirt and black apron putting a small folded paper on a little plate in front of Dad at a café table, Dad taking out his wallet.
more: Can I have the bill, please?
The electricity bill is high this month.
这个月的电费账单很高。

words.en: Lily gets a receipt from the shop.
words.sz: Lily 从商店拿到了一张收据。
words.scene: Lily holding a long paper receipt at the supermarket checkout (no readable writing).
more: Mum puts the receipt in her bag.
妈妈把收据放进了包里。

words.en: The shop assistant gives Lily her change.
words.scene: A grown-up woman shop assistant behind a sweet shop counter putting some coins into Lily's open hand, Lily holding a bag of sweets.
more: Can you change this note, please?
请能把这张纸币换开吗？
There is a big change in the weather today.

words.scene: small copper coins in Tom's hand (no numbers).
more: Tom finds a cent on the floor.
Tom 在地上捡到一美分。
One dollar is one hundred cents.

words.en: Tom saves a penny in his bank.
words.sz: Tom 把一便士存进他的储蓄罐。
words.scene: Tom putting one small copper coin into his piggy bank.
more: Grandma gave me a new penny.
奶奶给了我一枚新的一便士硬币。
One pound is one hundred pennies.

words.scene: a few round gold coins and a paper note on a shop counter (no numbers).
more: Dad has some pounds in his wallet.
爸爸钱包里有一些英镑。
One pound is one hundred pence.

words.en: Sam pays five dollars for the ice cream.
words.sz: Sam 付了五美元买冰淇淋。
words.scene: green paper notes in a wallet (no numbers).
more: Sam has a dollar in his pocket.
Sam's uncle pays in dollars in America.
Sam 的叔叔在美国用美元付钱。

words.en: Mum pays in euros at the market.
words.sz: 妈妈在市场用欧元付款。
words.scene: Mum paying at a market in Spain with coins and notes (no numbers).
more: Tom finds a euro under his chair.
Tom 在椅子底下找到一枚欧元。

words.en: The shop is open at nine o'clock.
words.scene: A grown-up man shop assistant in his thirties turning the key and pulling open the glass door of a bakery in the morning sun, fresh bread inside.
more: Is the park open on Sunday?

words.en: The shop closes at five o'clock.
words.scene: A grown-up woman shop assistant in her forties pulling down the metal shutter of a small shop in the evening, street lights coming on.
more: My school is close to my home.

words.scene: Lily and Mum standing outside a toy shop with the lights off and the metal shutter down, Lily looking disappointed.
more: 对不起，我们现在不营业了。
The window is closed. It's cold outside.

words.scene: Dad renting bikes at a bike shop on holiday.
more: Can I rent this film, please?
请问我可以租这部电影吗？
Grandpa rents a boat for the weekend.
爷爷租了一条船过周末。

words.en: Lily sees a big ad on the bus stop.
words.sz: Lily 在公交车站看到了一个大广告。
words.scene: a big colourful poster of a smiling girl with a new bike on a bus stop wall (no writing).
more: Dad read an ad in the newspaper.
爸爸在报纸上读了一则广告。

words.en: Tom watches an advertisement on the television.
words.scene: a TV showing an advertisement for orange juice, Tom watching from the sofa.
more: There is a long advertisement before the film.
Mum saw an advertisement for new shoes.
妈妈看到了新鞋子的广告。
